suggestions.rationale: Persistent ringing or similar auditory symptoms are commonly explored alongside noise-induced hearing loss in hearing-related claims.
evidenceGaps: Audiology records documenting both hearing loss and tinnitus symptoms
Current tinnitus diagnosis or clinician-confirmed symptom history
Opinion addressing whether the hearing loss caused or aggravated tinnitus

suggestions.rationale: Communication strain and chronic auditory symptoms may be explored alongside anxiety where records document psychosocial impact.
evidenceGaps: Mental health records documenting anxiety symptoms and functional impact
Opinion linking auditory-condition burden to anxiety aggravation

suggestions.rationale: Sleep disruption may be explored when tinnitus or hearing-related distress is documented as interfering with sleep continuity.
evidenceGaps: Sleep complaints tied to auditory symptoms in treatment notes
Current insomnia diagnosis or sleep-impairment assessment
Opinion addressing whether hearing-related symptoms aggravated insomnia
